title: Dog Night, 2026
logline: Twenty-seven years. The alley, the dumpster, the man from behind, the pup, twelve, sitting close. The sign above: how many tubes, reserved. The last Dog Night the book takes; the page is drawn like the first private one, exactly, five years on.

panels.composition: The alley behind the Lanes at night in rain: the dumpster, a man from behind in plaid under a rain shell, an old three-legged dog sitting close against his boot, the sign above with its dead tubes. The composition of ro_2021-11-15, exactly.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a night alley behind a bowling alley in rain with a dumpster, a man seen from behind in a rain shell over plaid flannel and an old three-legged dog sitting pressed against his boot, a neon sign with dead tubes above, no words
image.notes: Same composition as ro_2021-11-15. The dog older. No caption.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Twenty-seven. The first private Dog Night, again, the dog older.
